data.title: Serie A clubs’ Champions League Round of 16 hopes almost over already - Yahoo Sports
data.content: # Serie A clubs’ Champions League Round of 16 hopes almost over already. Serie A clubs have had a struggling start to the 2026-27 Champions League season, and hopes of having at least one Italian representative in the Round of 16 are already considerably reduced. Inter, Napoli, Como and Roma have accumulated only four points in their first two Champions League rounds. MILAN, ITALY – OCTOBER 13: Nicolo Tresoldi of Club Brugge KV scores his team's first goal from the penalty spot during the UEFA Champions League 2026/27 League Phase MD2 match between FC Internazionale Milano and Club Brugge KV at Stadio San Siro on October 13, 2026 in Milan, Italy. With only 18 points left before the end of the league phase, the chances of at least one Italian club finishing in the top eight and qualifying for the Round of 16 are already reduced.
